_help.background: The colour behind the whole board. Keep it dark so the hexes and pieces stand out.
_help.hexFill: The colour inside every empty hex, on the board and in the seed tray.
_help.hexLine: The colour of the thin line round every hex, on the board and in the seed tray.
_help.hexLineWidth: Higher = thicker lines round each hex; 0 = no lines. 0.06 is a fine line. Try 0.03–0.1.
_help.glowStrength: Each hex a glyphling can move to gets a patch of the player's colour with a dot in the middle. Higher = a more solid patch; lower = more see-through. The dot always stays solid. Try 0.3–0.6.
_help.pieceScale: 1 = a piece fills its hex edge to edge; lower = smaller pieces with a gap round them. Try 0.9–1.
_help.ghostOpacity: After you move a glyphling, a faded copy stays on its old hex (tap it to send the glyphling back). Higher = easier to see; 0 = invisible. Try 0.2–0.4.
_help.yellow: The yellow player's colour: their move and cast hexes, turn trails, the rings round their chosen and planned pieces, and their thrown seed.
_help.blue: The blue player's colour — used everywhere the yellow one is, for the blue player.
_help.plannedSeedLook: How an aimed seed that hasn't been thrown yet looks (always solid): moonlit = a silvery ghost with a bright letter (default) · stencil = a flat pale cut-out of the letter · misty = under a pale wash · greyed = grey and darker · dimmed = faded. The settings below each work for one look only. To change it, type the look's name in the file (garden.json).
_help.plannedMoonLight: Moonlit look only. The bright parts of the planned seed (its letter and border) turn this colour.
_help.plannedMoonShadow: Moonlit look only. The dark parts (the tile behind the letter) turn this colour. Keep it dark so the letter stands out.
_help.plannedMoonBrightness: Moonlit look only. Higher = a brighter letter (the tile gets a little lighter too); 1 = as bright as the real seed. Try 1.2–1.8.
_help.plannedStencilLetter: Stencil look only. The colour of the cut-out letter and border.
_help.plannedStencilTile: Stencil look only. The plain colour behind the letter.
_help.plannedStencilCut: Stencil look only. Lower = more of the seed's picture (sparkles, vines) turns letter-coloured; higher = only the brightest parts do, for a cleaner letter. Try 0.15–0.35.
_help.plannedStencilSoftness: Stencil look only. Low = crisp but jagged edges; high = smooth but blurry. Try 0.1–0.2.
_help.plannedMist: Misty look only. The colour of the pale wash laid over the planned seed.
_help.plannedMistStrength: Misty look only. Higher = a thicker wash that hides more of the seed; lower = the seed shows through more. Try 0.4–0.7.
_help.plannedSeedOpacity: Dimmed look only. Higher = the seed's picture shows in fuller colour; lower = it fades into a plain hex-coloured patch. Try 0.3–0.6.
_help.purple: The purple player's colour — used everywhere the yellow one is, for the purple player.
_help.pink: The pink player's colour — used everywhere the yellow one is, for the pink player.
_help.wordBorder: The colour of the outline round a word you are making (while aiming) and round the words that just grew. Neutral — never a player colour.
_help.wordBorderWidth: Higher = a thicker outline round made words. It sits behind the seeds, so only the part outside the letters shows. Only with word indicators on. Try 0.12–0.25.
_help.grownGlowStrength: How strong the outline is on the words that just grew (they stay outlined, one at a time, until play moves on). 1 = as strong as while aiming; lower = fainter; 0 = no outline once they grow. Try 0.6–1.
_help.spotlightLabel: On = the lit word also gets a small label with its Magic, placed where it covers no letters. Off = just the outline.
_help.spotlightLabelSize: Higher = bigger label text. 0.5 = half a hex tall. Try 0.4–0.6.
_help.spotlightLabelMinPx: The label never gets smaller than this, so it stays readable on small phone boards. Higher = bigger on phones. Try 12–16.
_help.seedShine: The colour of the little highlight dot on a seed while it flies through the air.
_help.warningWidth: A dashed "thorny" ring, in the owner's colour, round a glyphling with only ONE move left. Higher = a thicker, more alarming ring. Try 0.05–0.12.
_help.warningDash: Higher = longer dashes (the gaps grow a little too); lower = a finer, pricklier ring. Try 0.1–0.25.
_help.vine: The colour of the vine wrapped round a glyphling with no moves left.
_help.tangledDim: 1 = not faded at all; lower = the tangled glyphling fades more, so the vine stands out. Try 0.4–0.8.
_help.revealPop: The colour of the "+3" bonuses that pop up at the end of the game.
_help.scorePop: The colour of the "+1" / "+2" over each seed of a made word, and of the turn's total ("+6").
_help.scorePopSize: How big each seed's "+1" / "+2" is. Higher = bigger. Try 0.5–0.8.
_help.scoreTotalSize: How big the turn's total is over the glyphling that cast. Higher = bigger; keep it bigger than the "+1"s. Try 1–1.4.
_help.dropStrength: While you drag a piece, the legal hex under it lights up brighter than the other options, with a glow round its edge. Higher = brighter and more solid. Try 0.7–1.
_help.scorePopMinPx: The "+1"s never get smaller than this, so they stay readable on small phone boards; the total grows to match. Higher = bigger on phones. Try 14–20.
_help.castFill: Each hex a seed can be cast to gets the same patch + dot as a move hex, in a paler colour. This one = how solid the patch is (higher = less see-through; the dot always stays solid). How pale: the next setting. Try 0.5–0.9.
_help.trailWidth: The dotted path and rings, in the player's colour, that show where a glyphling moved and threw. Higher = thicker lines. Try 0.05–0.12.
_help.trailStrength: Higher = a more solid, easier-to-see trail; lower = more see-through. Shows while you plan your turn and while another player's turn is replayed; it goes once the seed lands. Try 0.6–1.
_help.castShade: The colour of the cast patches AND their dots, so a cast reads apart from a move at a glance. Up = paler, towards white (0.5 = halfway); 0 = same colour as a move; below 0 = darker, towards the night sky. This one = the colour; the one above = how solid. Try 0.3–0.5.

_labels.pieceScale: Seeds & glyphlings: how much of their hex they fill
_labels.glowStrength: Move hexes: how solid the colour patch is (0–1)
_labels.castFill: Cast hexes: how solid the colour patch is (0–1)
_labels.castShade: Cast hexes & dots: how much paler than move hexes
_labels.dropStrength: Drag: how bright the "drop here" hex is (0–1)
_labels.plannedSeedLook: Planned seed: which look (moonlit / stencil / misty / greyed / dimmed)
_labels.plannedMoonShadow: Moonlit look: tile colour behind the letter
_labels.plannedStencilTile: Stencil look: tile colour behind the letter
_labels.plannedStencilCut: Stencil look: how much of the picture becomes letter
_labels.plannedMistStrength: Misty look: how thick the wash is (0–1)
_labels.plannedSeedOpacity: Dimmed look: how strong the seed picture is (0–1)
_labels.ghostOpacity: Ghost glyphling (where it started): how visible (0–1)
_labels.grownGlowStrength: Word outline after the words grow: how solid (0–1)
_labels.spotlightLabel: Word spotlight: show the word + Magic label ("QUA +4")
_labels.spotlightLabelMinPx: Word spotlight label: smallest text on screen (pixels)
_labels.tangledDim: Tangled glyphling: how visible under the vine (0–1)
